full_page.content:
Page 34
June 8 Rey Bekaert - 21 - operated on for - after 3 weeks of sickness, now worse than ever ....
Mrs. Cath. Sutter - 79 - finger badly burned several weeks ago, lately getting worse .... alarmed.
10 Mrs. Metilda Mellon ... about 55 - like stroke this a.m. Vincent Termini - 48 - Ulcers of stomach. Marg. Fletcher - 35 - operation in St. Mary's To-day.
Francis Regis Haughey - 6 - very sick when 2 since that mentally deficient.
13 Geo Burkart - 59 - Lutherin - threatening tuomer of lungs .. Very little of hope by Drs ... Enrolled To-day 1.00
Thanks - Sherman Laisure - 21 - Mercy Hospital Bay City - March 22 - Sister phones from hospital - in oxigen for 6 weeks between life and death brain hemorage and pneumonia - Dr. bills 2500.00 .... Working every day - better than ever ... Enro.
Page 35 June 14 Mrs. Helen Rauson - 57 - glacoma - one eye almost hopeless. Drs fear transfer of malady to other eye. Same Mrs. H.R. baptized Catholic; Mother died when only a baby, Father 0 - took her away from Church.
15th Mrs. Cecelia Mayes - 47 - inward cancer very threatening. About a year ago had similar condition and was cured ... Lately trouble is again manifest.
Dolores Balor - 7 - pneumonia now for 6-7 week - struggling ... 17 better fever gone.
16 Eliz. Wagner - 48 - dying of cancer - unless prayers ... · A. J. Skiffington - 72 - Stomach condition threatening cancer.
20 Celisla Barnes - 92 - Baptist - 2 strokes just recently - Enrolled $5. To-night ....
Celine Berger - 8 - in Children Hosp'l - Drs fear infection of brain - enrolled 50c
